_provenance.description: Real, repeatedly-used YouTube title formats with measured usage counts and performance. Every row is an aggregate over real videos.
_provenance.source: TubeAI MCP `list_title_formats` (aggregates over a 200M+ video / 4M+ channel index)
_provenance.caveat_avg_outlier: avg_outlier is an ARITHMETIC MEAN of a heavy-tailed quantity, so it is inflated by a handful of extreme videos ('How [thing] Is Made' = 130.3 from 169 uses). We do NOT use it raw. model.mjs applies James-Stein-style shrinkage toward the corpus median, weighted by `uses`, before the number is allowed to influence ranking. `uses` and `avg_views` are far more robust and carry most of the weight.
_provenance.topic_safe_note: topic_safe lists the formats that stay grammatical when the subject is an abstract topic (a series, a concept, a faction) rather than a physical object or a named human. Curated by hand: 'How [thing] Is Made' is excluded because 'How One Piece Theory Is Made' is nonsense, even though the slot type matches. Generation draws only from this list, plus person_only formats when the user supplies --people.
